test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"behold."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Behold"** means to see or observe something, often with wonder or amazement. (किसी चीज़ को अक्सर आश्चर्य या विस्मय के साथ देखना या निरीक्षण करना) • **Example**: ***Behold**__ the beauty of the sunset!* • It is a verb and requires an object to complete the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 1. • **Correct passage:** A beautiful spectacle for anyone to __**behold**__ would be the crowds that throng to see the Indian cricket team playing, whether it be in India or in other parts of the globe. This ______ (2) ______ is the occasion where the spirit of oneness is all pervasive. India with all its diversity ______ (3) ______ be seen either rejoicing or moaning depending on the sway of the game ______ (4) ______ watched. Unity in diversity is ______ (5) ______ in all its glory. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "tarnish",** means to damage the purity or luster of something. ((धातु आदि की) चमक घट जाना या घटा देना) • **Option 3, "vanish", **means to disappear suddenly or completely. (एकाएक ग़ायब हो जाना (ऐसे कि पता न चले), ओझल हो जाना) • **Option 4, "sold",** is a past tense verb meaning to exchange something for money. (किसी को कुछ बेचना (दाम लेकर वस्‍तु देना, और ग्राहक का वस्‍तु का स्‍वामी हो जाना)) 1b9:Tc87, The correct answer is **"undoubtedly."**
